cohort_total_n_excerpt: A case-control study (147 PC cases, 300 controls) was conducted in Córdoba (Argentina) throughout 2008-2013.
reason: The study evaluated prostate cancer occurrence overall in relation to dietary patterns. No aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal endpoint is described.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: High adherence to the Traditional (OR 2.82, 95%CI: 1.569-5.099) and Carbohydrate Patterns (OR 2.14, 95%CI: 1.470-3.128) showed a promoting effect for PC, whereas the Prudent and Cheese Patterns were independent factors.
estimate_classifications.reason: The Cheese Pattern row concerns the study's overall prostate cancer endpoint. Its numeric estimate comes from supplied full-text evidence, while the abstract supports classification of the Cheese Pattern analysis as general prostate cancer.
